additional_info.subject: ID0477462-DC/Si-D/IT- [MP / S9 170004060] Logs Check CRM:03289000508
additional_info.body:
Hi Maria ,
I hope this email finds you well.
I could check more information with our experts and regarding the first charger, indeed the car was not connected and the reason on the logs we can see on this screenshot.
Charging session starting at 18:09 and starting the authentication.
After this the authentication failed showing a network issue and missing internet on the charger the authentication was not accepted.
The network was unreachable until the error from the outlet 2 shows on this log, and for this reason the EVready was showing at zero.
Regarding the second charger, I was checking the session I shared with you but it didn't fail on the authentication.
Can I ask you to share a specific timestamp to check on our side please?
With best regards
,
eMobility Technical Support Team – Felipe Moraes
Please do not change the subject line when replying to this email.
